description.en:
Operator Gavial the Invincible has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for swift and fierce enemy suppression in combat.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Guard Operator during field operations to exercise Centurion responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
description.zh:
干员百炼嘉维尔擅长以凌厉攻势阻击敌人
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为近卫干员，行使强攻手职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en: Torches crackle softly in the low wooden hut. A gust of wind whistles through the cracks in the boards. A few shadows gently sway. 'Come in.' The hut door is hefted open, and a mass of somewhat hasty green squeezes into the firelit space, having to get far more intimate with the doorframe than doorframes typically experience. 'Got everything?' 'Y—You bet...' Gavial gives her head an impromptu massage. 'Bring it out.' Gavial hoists her tail back to bundle up the bag behind her, and takes great care to open it up on the table. Out fall a wide assortment of weapons. Those standing around the table grab one each. 'Dagger.' 'Cutting edge is sharp. Signs of whetstoning.' Another voice makes itself known. Gavial twists her head around looking for it, only to quickly give up and pull it back. 'Chainsaw.' 'No junk in the chain, lubrication on drive shaft is fresh, and handle wraps have been changed before. Motor system is running well, power system is stable.' 'Uh-huh. The axe?' 'About the same condition as the chainsaw. The only difference is the axe has some slight rusting...' 'Don't mind her. The metal was rusted when I made it.' Yet another voice has emerged. '...Didn't you tell me you used the best materials?' 'Those are the best materials. Even the 'Rage Ironhide' didn't get it as good as this.' 'Quit it a sec, you two, we're not done yet... Gavial.' 'Here...' 'Where's your staff?' 'Muhh, my staff...' Gavial hangs her head low. 'Where is your staff? Bring it out.' Gavial realizes she's not winning this, grinds her teeth, and pulls her staff out of her boot. Well, boots. 'Staff's... broken.' 'How did you break it?' 'Clobbering people out there over the last few days. I just gave it a whack once and... it snapped.' 'How? You know I reinforced it. All you had to do was take good care of it and... Gavial, give me the inspection form. Have you filled it in properly?' 'No duh I did!' 'What were you doing last month on the 3rd? You were meant to give it maintenance that day, but you've written nothing here. Did you forget?' 'Did not. I was, uh, I was busy that day with... oh! No, I got it! I was scrapping with the Durins' machines! You even gave them the blueprints for those!' 'I do recall that, but it doesn't change the fact you wrecked your staff, so...' Gavial sucks in a deep, deep breath. 'So like you laid out. Five days without eating meat. I'm ready for it...' After a brief silence, with the table shooting a few glances between each other, there's the sudden telltale 'pfft' of a laugh. 'What the hell's so funny... Tomimi? Zumama? Inam! What are you guys laughing for?' Gavial asks through a frown of complete suspicion. Inam is scratching at her head. 'Gavial, the fact that you can take proper care of your weapons is impressive. I wonder if we can thank the statue being erected...' 'I literally guaranteed you guys! You didn't even believe me?!' 'We're only finding out in the first place because people tell us you keep complaining about weapon upkeep being a hassle,' Zumama explains. 'We wouldn't let you go without meat for five days, Gavial... that would be too scary for you,' Tomimi quietly adds. Gavial sighs a slow sigh of relief. 'Scared the hell outta me. I seriously thought you guys were gonna have me lashed down...' 'I'll make you another staff. Remember to care for it regularly!' 'Yeah, you don't have to tell me... huh? Something smells good. Is that—' 'That said, seeing how we know you, we decided we'd punish you via other means... This is a whole pot of Acahualla-sourced meat stew!' Inam unveils. 'Gavial, you have to stand over there and watch us while we eat the entire thing.' Gavial's eyes pop out of her skull. 'You guys are torturers! ACTUAL TORTURERS!'
description.zh:
火把在低矮的木屋里安静燃烧着，一阵风从木板的缝隙间吹来，几道影子微微摇晃。
“进来吧。”
木屋的门被用力搬开，一抹绿色略显急迫地挤进火光中，以至于与门框发生了亲密接触。
“东西带齐了吗？”
“带、带齐了……”嘉维尔揉着脑袋。
“都拿出来。”
嘉维尔用尾巴卷起身后的袋子，小心翼翼地在桌子上解开，各式武器散落开来。桌对面的人拎起了一把武器。
“刀。”
“刃口锋利，有打磨过的痕迹。”
另一个声音响起，嘉维尔拧过头看了一眼，旋即缩回脑袋。
“链锯。”
“锯链上没有杂物，传动轴上的油很新，手把绑带也更换过。传动系统运转良好，供能系统稳定。”
“嗯。斧头呢？”
“和链锯情况差不多。唯一不同的是斧面上有一些锈迹……”
“不关她的事。我制作时那块就生锈了。”又一个声音冒了出来。
“……你不是说用的是最好的材料吗？”
“这就是最好的材料。‘暴躁铁皮’上用的材料都没它好。”
“你们两个停一停，事情还没结束……嘉维尔。”
“在……”
“法杖呢？”
“法、法杖……”嘉维尔垂下脑袋。
“法杖在哪里？拿出来。”
嘉维尔眼见事情瞒不住，一咬牙，从靴子里抽出了法杖。
“法杖……坏了。”
“怎么坏的？”
“前几天在外面揍人的时候，我就那么一抡……就坏了。”
“怎么可能？我明明加强了法杖的强度，只要好好保养……嘉维尔，把检查表给我。你有好好填吗？”
“那当然！”
“上个月三号你在干什么？那天是你该来保养的日子，可上面什么都没有写。你忘了吗？”
“没有。那天、那天我很忙……哦！你知道！我在和杜林人的机器打架！图纸都是你给他们的！”
“好像是有这么一回事，但是你还是把法杖弄坏了，所以……”
嘉维尔深深吸了一口气：“当初说的是五天不吃肉。我准备好了……”
短暂的安静后，桌后的几人对视了几眼，忽然“扑哧”笑了出来。
“有什么好笑的……特米米？祖玛玛？依娜姆！你们在笑什么？”嘉维尔一脸疑惑。
依娜姆抓了抓脑袋：“嘉维尔竟然也会认真保养武器了，是竖起雕像的关系吗……”
“我向你们保证过的！你们还不相信我？！”
“还不是听人说你经常会抱怨保养武器麻烦，我们才来检查。”祖玛玛解释道。
“我们不会让嘉维尔五天不吃肉的……那对嘉维尔来说太恐怖了。”特米米小声说。
嘉维尔长舒一口气：“吓死我了。我还真以为要受折磨……”
“我会再给你做一根法杖的。以后也要记得按时保养！”
“知道啦……嗯？好香，这味道——”
“不过凭着对你的了解，我们还是准备了其他的惩罚……一大锅丛林炖肉！”依娜姆说道，“嘉维尔，你只能站在那里看着我们吃完哦。”
嘉维尔瞪大眼睛：“这是折磨！折磨啊！”

description.en: Once more, Gavial smashes open the door, grabs Minimalist by the collar, and hauls him to the infirmary. 'I told you, I'll be there as soon as I finish this design!' 'But your blueprints haven't changed a bit since yesterday!' 'I'm just waiting for that lightbulb to go off in my head!' 'That's Avdotya's thing, Stitch, not yours. If you keep delaying the treatment, the only things going into your head will be my fists.' 'Didn't you say you only beat up bad guys?' Gavial grins smugly. 'I'll make an exception just for you, especially if you keep refusing treatment.' Minimalist's face flickers between anger and a suspicious grin. 'He's definitely plotting something,' Gavial thinks. But whatever scheme he comes up with, she couldn't care less. For the next week, Minimalist stops talking about designs, drawings, or inspiration. Eventually, Gavial makes an inquiry. 'So how's that design you were working on?' 'It's fine.' 'Is it for the entertainment facilities in New Zeruertza?' 'Something like that. Hmph. It's a surprise—ow!' The needle is removed, the injection is complete. Gavial is utterly uninterested in whatever 'surprise' Minimalist is cooking up. Another week passes. A message arrives: Gavial has been chosen as a special guest for the next big celebration in New Zeruertza, and a 'surprise' has been prepared. Inam tells her that if she has time, she should come back, take a look, and do the ribbon-cutting. 'A surprise?' she mutters, puzzled. Just then, a crowd bursts into the infirmary. Minimalist trails behind with a large box in his arms. 'Inam figured you wouldn't have time in your busy schedule, so we brought you your gift ahead of time,' says Zumama. 'It's a scale model of your new statue.' 'A new statue? Didn't they already build one? And I specifically told them not to give it a thick tail.' 'Well, you'll have to ask Stitch about that. He's the one who designed this latest one.' An uneasy feeling rises in her. Stitch steps forward. 'This is for you, Gavial. A token of thanks for all you've done for New Zeruertza.' He opens the box. Inside is a miniature statue of Gavial, with a thick, oversized tail jutting from the back. Gavial's face cycles through a wave of different emotions. 'If that's to scale, then won't the tail on the real statue be thicker than her entire body?' Tomimi asks. 'If it's supposed to be proportional, then use my actual proportions!' Gavial growls, teeth clenched. 'This is way thicker than it should be!' Stitch starts clapping. He can tell that she really does care about his little 'surprise' after all. Weeks later, Zumama pushes open the door to find Gavial using the little statue to sharpen her chainsaw. 'Sharpening your weapon, Gavial?' 'No, just trying to grind down this statue's stupid tail!' 'Where's Stitch?' 'How should I know? Ugh. Alright. I just think that before I go back for the ribbon-cutting, somebody had better make sure the statue in Acahualla has its tail resized right.' 'Or else what? Is that a threat?' Gavial lifts her chainsaw, its blade gleaming bright from the polishing. Gavial decides to let her threat remain a mystery for now.
description.zh:
又一次，嘉维尔砸开房门，抓着领子把至简提到了医疗室。
“我都说了，等我做完这份设计就会过去！”
“可你的图纸看起来和昨天一样，没变化。”
“我在等待灵感飞落到我的头顶！”
“少学阿芙朵嘉那套，斯第奇。你下次要是再敢拖延治疗，飞落到你头顶的将会是我的拳头，两只！”
“你不是说你只揍坏人吗？”
嘉维尔得意地笑起来。“你生病了，不就是身体坏了？生病还不好好接受治疗，真是坏上加坏！”
至简脸上的表情忽而愤怒，忽而窃喜。
“肯定在打坏主意了。”嘉维尔想。
至于什么坏主意，嘉维尔才不在乎。
接下来的一周，至简再也没提过什么设计、图纸或灵感。于是嘉维尔问：
“你之前在做的设计怎么样了？”
“还好。”
“是给新际崖城设计的游乐设施吗？”
“差不多。哼，这是一份惊喜——啊！痛！”
针头拔出，注射完成。
至于什么惊喜，嘉维尔才不在乎。
又一周过去。口信传来，嘉维尔被选为了新际崖城下一次大型庆典的特别嘉宾，神秘惊喜已建好。依娜姆让嘉维尔有空的话回去看看，顺便剪个彩。
“惊喜？”
她正疑惑时，一群人挤进了医疗室，走在最后的至简抱着一个大盒子。
“依娜姆猜到你肯定没空，所以提前将惊喜礼物送来了。听说是根据你的新雕像等比例制作的微缩模型。”祖玛玛说。
“新雕像？之前不是已经修过一座了吗——我特意要求过不许做成粗尾巴的那座？”
“那你得问斯第奇，他才是新雕像的设计师。”
嘉维尔心头浮现起一股不好的预感。
至简走上前。
“这是送给你的，嘉维尔。感谢你为新际崖城所做的一切。”
他揭开盒子盖，一个小巧的嘉维尔雕像出现在众人面前，但从雕像背后伸出来的，是一条粗粗的尾巴。
嘉维尔脸上的表情变得极为精彩。
“如果是等比例缩小的，那原雕像上的尾巴，是不是会比嘉维尔整个人还粗？”特米米问。
“既然是‘等比例’，就按我的真实比例来做啊——这也比实际上粗太多了吧！”嘉维尔几乎是咬牙切齿地说。
至简领头鼓起掌来。他看得出，这份惊喜，嘉维尔很在乎。
几周后，祖玛玛推开房间门时，嘉维尔正在用那座小雕像磨锯链的刃片。
“嘉维尔，你居然在自觉利用闲暇时间保养武器？”
“我不闲，我正忙着把这个雕像的尾巴磨细！”
“斯第奇去哪儿了？”
“我怎么知道——好吧，我只是说，在我回去给它补办剪彩仪式之前，最好有人负责让阿卡胡拉那座雕像的尾巴恢复它该有的尺寸。”
“不然呢，会有什么后果？”
嘉维尔拎起锯链看了看，刃片被打磨得寒光四射。
至于什么后果，嘉维尔才不在乎。
